summary: A heavy Sunday of European league football, three NFL games, the ESL Pro League final and early ATP Shanghai/WTA Wuhan matches. Kept legs are mostly at or slightly below bookmaker consensus; many legs were excluded for unconfirmed availability of key players coming out of the international break, plus Challenger/WTA 125 tennis.
